description: Docs gap: GET /accounts/{account_id}/workers/durable_objects/namespaces also returns `dispatch_namespace` for namespaces owned by a Workers for Platforms dispatch-namespace script (absent for account-level scripts). Without it, a dispatch script's namespaces are indistinguishable from those of an account-level script with the same name. Observed on a live listing on 2026-10-09: `{"id": "…", "class": "Counter", "name": "<script>_Counter", "script": "<script>", "use_sqlite": true, "dispatch_namespace": "<namespace>"}`.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Workers for Platforms dispatch namespace of the script that owns this namespace; absent for account-level scripts.
